svg.title: ContextGem: Extract structured data and insights from documents using LLMs and decision models
svg.desc: On a dark ground in a thin pixel frame, the ContextGem wordmark, the line "Extract structured data and insights from documents using LLMs and decision models", "Describe, don't prompt." and "Shcherbak AI". On the right, a pixel-art page of a document with two of its lines marked in blue: one leads to an LLM, the other to a decision model, and both lead on to a blue gem.
